root_cause.text: An off-by-one error in the loop condition of `nvme_dbbuf_set()` causes the loop to iterate up to `dev->online_queues` (inclusive) instead of `dev->online_queues - 1`, leading to a slab-out-of-bounds access on the `dev->queues` array.

bic_trace_step.reason: This commit introduces the vulnerable loop in `nvme_dbbuf_set()`: `for (i = 1; i <= dev->online_queues; i++) nvme_dbbuf_free(&dev->queues[i]);`.
